title: Public journal/story site with single-author posting, media attachments, and II-gated locked posts

requirements.text: Implement backend data model and APIs for a single-author journal with posts that can be marked as free or locked, including create/update/delete and public read access.

quotes: i want to document my daily activities and stories... add features like photos, videos ...
some posts be free and others locked.

acceptanceCriteria: Posts are persisted in the canister and survive reloads/upgrades (use stable storage patterns appropriate for Motoko).
Each post includes at minimum: id, title, body text, createdAt timestamp, updatedAt timestamp, isLocked boolean, and a list of media attachments (may be empty).
Backend exposes query for listing posts (with pagination parameters) and query for fetching a single post by id.
Backend exposes update calls for owner to create, edit, delete posts.
For non-owner callers, backend read APIs do not return locked post content unless access rules in REQ-3 are satisfied.

requirements.text: Add an owner-only authoring/admin workflow so only the site owner can create and manage posts.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has an Admin area/page that is visible/enabled only for the configured owner principal.
Owner can create a new post, edit an existing post, and delete a post from the UI.
If a non-owner attempts to call create/update/delete backend methods directly, the backend rejects the call with a clear error.
Owner identity is determined by caller principal and a configured owner principal constant (document where to set it).

requirements.text: Gate locked posts behind Internet Identity login: users can browse free content publicly, but must sign in with Internet Identity to view locked post content.

quotes: log in with Internet Identity before viewing pay‑walled content

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visitors can view the post list and open free posts fully.
Unauthenticated visitors attempting to open a locked post see a locked state UI and a prompt to sign in with Internet Identity.
After signing in, the app re-attempts to load the locked post content.
Backend enforces the rule by checking caller identity; frontend gating alone is not considered sufficient.

requirements.text: Implement a minimal paywall entitlement mechanism for locked posts (without integrating payments): after Internet Identity login, only principals that are explicitly allowed can view locked content; the owner can grant/revoke access.

quotes: some posts be free and others locked

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores an allowlist (set of principals) who may view locked posts; owner can add/remove principals via admin calls.
Locked post read returns full content for the owner and allowlisted principals; otherwise returns a not-authorized result.
Frontend provides an owner-only UI to add/remove principals to the allowlist (copy/paste principal text).
Non-allowlisted logged-in users see a clear ‘not subscribed/authorized’ state for locked posts (in English).

requirements.text: Support media attachments on posts in the initial version: allow adding images and videos to a post, and display them in post detail views.
acceptanceCriteria: A post can include multiple media attachments, each typed as either image or video.
The create/edit post UI supports adding media entries.
Post detail view renders image attachments and video attachments appropriately (responsive layout).
Locked post media is gated the same as locked post text content (no media URLs/blobs returned to unauthorized callers).

requirements.text: Create public-facing pages for browsing and reading posts: a home/feed page, a post detail page, and basic navigation.

quotes: document my daily activities and stories

acceptanceCriteria: Home/feed page lists posts newest-first with title, date, and a locked indicator for locked posts.
Post detail page shows title, date, body, and media (subject to access rules).
Navigation includes links to Home and (when owner) Admin; and a login/logout control for Internet Identity.
UI is usable on mobile and desktop (responsive layout).

requirements.text: Add a coherent visual theme and typography system for the journal app and apply it consistently across pages.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a distinct, cohesive theme (not blue/purple by default) with consistent spacing, typography, and component styling.
Theme is applied consistently across Home, Post Detail, and Admin pages.
User-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Add basic content safety/quality constraints and empty/loading states throughout the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Forms validate required fields (e.g., title/body) and show inline English error messages.
All data-fetching views show loading states and error states.
When there are no posts, Home shows an empty-state message and (for owner) a call-to-action to create the first post.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in the main actor file (backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (compose existing hooks/components instead of modifying them).
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is allowed.
Do not integrate external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
nonGoals: Implementing real payment processing (e.g., Stripe) in this iteration.
Allowing other users to create posts or comments.
Health progress tracking features (defer to later).
Full-featured video hosting/streaming inside the canister beyond reasonable size limits.

required: Minimalist wordmark logo in warm charcoal and cream palette (logo.dim_512x512.png)
Subtle paper-grain background texture, light warm tone (paper-texture.dim_1600x900.png)
